# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made on the default branch and in the latest release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately in one of these ways:

- Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bytesbybrandon/ip-search-mcp/security/advisories/new) on GitHub.
- Email brandon@bytesbybrandon.com.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the version or commit you tested.
We aim to acknowledge a report within a week and to tell you what we plan to do about it.
Please give us a reasonable chance to ship a fix before you disclose the problem publicly.

Do not include API keys or tokens in a report. Describe where the key came from instead.
